svg.title: Add positional vectors to token embeddings
svg.desc: Positional vectors are added once to token embeddings. Sinusoidal encodings use geometrically spaced frequencies to provide position information.

g.text: Add positional vectors to token embeddings
Sinusoids encode order with unique periodic signals while keeping the input width fixed.
FROM TOKEN ID TO ORDER-AWARE INPUT
Sinusoidal frequencies are geometric: fast and slow “odometer wheels.”
